title: Parish and Verdict
author: Lior Vasquez
blurb: Orsen Pemberton, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
